source_integrity_flags: Serious adverse event placebo analysis differs between main text (n=10,703; RR 0.99, 95% CI 0.87-1.12) and S2 Table (n=11,140; RR 0.99, 95% CI 0.88-1.13).
Severe hypoglycaemia placebo analysis differs in participant total: main text n=5,077 versus S2 Table n=5,083.
Fasting-plasma-glucose pooled effect is reported as -28.1 mg/dL in Table 2 and -0.9 mmol/L in Results prose without reconciliation.
Triglyceride pooled 95% CI is printed as -0.16 to +0.02 mmol/L in Table 2 but described as -0.16 to -0.02 mmol/L in Results prose.
Cardiovascular-event participant totals differ between main-text arm counts and the S2 Table total.
